name: 48304 · Bloomfld Hls, MI
findings: ZIP 48304 (Bloomfld Hls) has 197 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48304 (Bloomfld Hls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
